title: Phyto-engineered Pd-doped WO3 nanocomposite via Anisomeles indica leaf extract: a recyclable heterogeneous catalyst for aqueous Petasis reaction, photocatalytic dye degradation, and antibacterial applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,41995-42008
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06905J, Paper

Nilesh Pandit, Avdhut Kadam, Avinash Survase, Prit Ashara, Avdhut Patil, Chaitali Bagade, Sarika Patil, Santosh Kamble
Phyto-synthesized Pd–WO3 nanocomposite via Anisomeles indica leaf extract under ultrasonication. Exhibits high catalytic activity in the Petasis reaction, rapid methylene blue dye degradation, and strong antibacterial properties.
